app.name: ohmycds
app.description:
中文简介

CDS GitHub App 用于将 GitHub 仓库接入 Cloud Dev Suite，自动同步仓库、分支和 Pull Request 事件，触发代码拉取、构建与分支预览部署。它帮助团队为每个分支快速生成可访问的预览环境，并在 CDS 控制台中集中管理项目、部署状态、构建日志和运行服务。

English Description

The CDS GitHub App connects GitHub repositories to Cloud Dev Suite, synchronizing repository, branch, and pull request events to trigger code checkout, builds, and branch preview deployments. It helps teams quickly create accessible preview environments for every branch while managing projects, deployment status, build logs, and running services from the CDS dashboard.
